components.name: Brand
components.description: eiDotter brand mark — Logo (yolk + highlight + specular at 32×32, brand-locked amber hexes), Wordmark (text eiDotter with dimmed prefix), or BrandLockup (Logo + Wordmark side-by-side).

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary user action. 6 variants × 5 sizes × 4 states = 120. Use primary for the dominant action, secondary for less emphasis, tertiary for low-priority, destructive for irreversible operations, ghost for chrome, link for navigation embedded in text.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field with React Aria TextField under the hood. Variants cover idle / focused / error / disabled. Use for short text input — for multi-line content compose with Card body slot or build a textarea.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Boolean toggle with phosphor glow on the active state. Use for instant on/off settings. Prefer Checkbox when the change is part of a form being submitted.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Boolean selection using DOS bracket-text [ ] / [x] / [-]. Use in lists, settings, and forms. Indeterminate state for parent items in a tree.

components.name: FilterBar
components.description: Composes Tag (closeable) instances with a label and clear-all action. Use as the active-filters row above a result list.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status indicator for counts, labels, and inline status. 5 colors × 2 sizes. Non-interactive — for clickable filter chips use Tag.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Interactive label with optional close affordance and keyboard support (Delete/Backspace dismisses when closeable). 5 colors × 2 sizes × static/closeable. Compose into FilterBar for active-filter rows.

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container. Default for plain surfaces, elevated for cards that should appear above the page (drop shadow), accent for cards that need an amber border emphasis.

components.name: Stat
components.description: Metric value + label + optional trend indicator. 3 sizes × with/without trend. The trend arrow uses CGA semantic colors (success green for up, error red for down).

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline status message with optional actions and close. V.37 spec: uniform dark background, featured icon, color-tinted border. Use for in-flow status; for floating toast use Notification.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Overlay dialog. 3 sizes (sm 360px, md 480px, lg 640px). The backdrop is composed by the consumer — Modal renders the dialog only. Use effects/overlay token at z-index/modal.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Loading bar using DOS block characters (filled and empty) inside a bracketed track. 4 example values shipped (0/25/50/100); designers can override the fill ratio per instance.

components.name: Notification
components.description: Toast message. 5 colors × icon-with-double-rings × layered amber-glow shadow. Purely presentational — consumers handle positioning, auto-dismiss timing, and stacking.

components.name: CmdPalette
components.description: Cmd+K command palette overlay. Search + section header + result list with selected-state highlight + footer keyboard hints. Composes with Modal-style backdrop on the consumer side.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Navigation trail with / separators. Last item is the current page (full opacity), preceding items are link-style (70% opacity).

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tab list + active panel. Active tab has bottom-border in border-focus color + small phosphor glow. Inactive tabs use muted text color.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Collapsible section with chevron indicator. 2 variants — collapsed (chevron-down) and expanded (chevron-up + body content + divider). Compose multiple stacked accordions for FAQ-style lists.

components.name: Nav
components.description: Horizontal navigation row. Active item gets text-accent color + bottom-border indicator with amber phosphor glow.

components.name: Header
components.description: Sticky site header. Retro variant has the amber phosphor border-bottom + glow on the active nav item; modern variant uses thin gray border + subtle indicator.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Site footer with branding column + link columns + divider + copyright row. Use middle-dot to separate copyright fragments.

components.name: Separator
components.description: Visual divider. Horizontal (1px tall, full-width) for stacked content, vertical (1px wide, full-height) for inline content.

components.name: InlineLink
components.description: In-flow navigational anchor with phosphor inversion on hover (amber background + dark text). Internal links get a triangle glyph; external links get a diagonal arrow (rendered as fallback square in Perfect DOS VGA 437 Win — designers may override).

components.name: InlineExpand
components.description: Inline disclosure widget. Collapsed shows a trigger sentence with a triangle glyph; expanded reveals content beneath with a left amber border. Use for citation-style detail in body copy — quieter than an accordion.

components.name: LegalPage
components.description: Layout primitive for Impressum / Datenschutz pages. h1 + Stand-date hero + intro + h2 sections + address block. 14px body scale codified locally (eidotters default text-sm at 20px is too big for legal-document body).

components.name: Icon
components.description: 12 public glyph names mapping to 11 unique pixelarticons + 1 custom (Close uses a custom PixelX since pixelarticons v2 has no standalone X glyph).

components.name: CommandPrompt
components.description: DOS prompt with C:\\> prefix and a blinking cursor block. Empty state shows just the prompt + cursor; typed shows the entered command.

components.name: DosFigure
components.description: Demoscene-style media placeholder — title strip + framed subject + bottom-right resolution badge + caption. Use as a lead-in for blog articles or where a photograph would otherwise go.

components.name: Terminal
components.description: DOS window chrome — title bar with min/max/close controls + body slot. Active variant has amber title bar with dark text; inactive variant is dark with amber text.

components.name: ChatMessage
components.description: Single chat message. Role (user/assistant/system) determines the prefix glyph and color; streaming variant adds a cursor block at the message end.

components.name: ChatInput
components.description: > prompt + input field + [ SEND ] action. Variants cover empty / focused (with cursor and amber glow) / disabled.

components.name: ChatHistory
components.description: Scrollable list of ChatMessage instances showing a real conversation flow (system stamp + user/assistant turns + final streaming message).

components.name: ChatContainer
components.description: Composes ChatHistory + focused ChatInput inside a Terminal-style frame with hard amber drop shadow.

components.name: TimelineNode
components.description: Single timeline marker. 3 shapes (circle / square / diamond) × 2 states (default amber-dim / active amber + glow). Resize per usage.

variables.name: color/semantic/text/muted
variables.description: Muted supplementary text — timestamps, counts, footnotes. T10 handoff: dedicated amber-dim hex (in-family with primary), not brown; no opacity coupling.

variables.name: color/semantic/alert/info
variables.description: Warm dark blue for info alerts

variables.name: color/semantic/alert/success
variables.description: Warm dark green for success alerts

variables.name: color/semantic/alert/error
variables.description: Warm dark red for error alerts

variables.name: typography/fontFamily/primary
variables.description: Aliases Foundation typography/fontFamily/primary. Web semantic re-export — consumers binding to this token in Web DS components automatically inherit Foundation rebrands.

variables.name: typography/fontFamily/fallback
variables.description: Bare monospace stack — fail-loud diagnostic counterpart to primary. Compose with primary when consumers want strict Perfect-DOS-or-nothing rendering.

variables.name: opacity/0
variables.description: Stored as percent (0-100) for Figma binding compatibility. CSS consumers read from src/tokens/*.tokens.json which stores 0-1 form.

variables.name: effects/phosphorGlow
variables.description: Phosphor bloom/bleeding glow for CRT effects

variables.name: effects/crtBackground
variables.description: Dark warm-black for CRT screen (not pure black)

variables.name: effect/web/scanline/line-width
variables.description: Thin-line width in scanline gradient (web-only — Apple shader uses UV-fraction).

variables.name: effect/web/scanline/scroll-distance
variables.description: How far scanline overlay drifts before looping (web-only — Apple uses time-based UV scrolling).

variables.name: effect/web/flicker/steps
variables.description: CSS steps() discretization (web-only — Apple shader is continuous).

variables.name: effect/web/flicker/intensity-static
variables.description: Non-animated reduced-motion fallback opacity (web-only — Apple uses runtime accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion flag, not a token).

variables.name: effect/web/bloom/fade-stop
variables.description: CSS radial-gradient stop where bloom transparency begins (web-only — CIBloom has no gradient-stop equivalent).

variables.name: effect/web/vignette/gradient-extent-x
variables.description: CSS radial-gradient ellipse X size in % (web-only).

variables.name: effect/web/vignette/gradient-extent-y
variables.description: CSS radial-gradient ellipse Y size in % (web-only).

variables.name: effect/web/vignette/transition-edge
variables.description: Outer-edge gradient stop where deepest vignette begins (web-only).

variables.name: effect/web/power/scale-pre-collapse
variables.description: CSS transform: scale() start during power-off (web-only).

variables.name: effect/web/power/scale-collapse-line
variables.description: Thin horizontal line mid-state during collapse (web-only).

variables.name: effect/web/power/duration-off
variables.description: Web-only power-off animation duration. Apple platforms have own timing curves.

variables.name: opacity/20
variables.description: Notification ring inner — 20% opacity. Stored as percent (0-100) for Figma binding compatibility.

variables.name: opacity/60
variables.description: Tag close-glyph — 60% opacity. Stored as percent (0-100) for Figma binding compatibility.

variables.name: opacity/70
variables.description: Breadcrumb non-current items — 70% opacity. Stored as percent (0-100) for Figma binding compatibility.

variables.name: spacing/6px
variables.description: Tag gap-1.5 (md size) + Switch handle. Tailwind gap-1.5.
